description:
Leonard Wilson Keenan 

A name to remember 
3 Bedroom Semi-Detached Family Home | 1 Bathroom | Corner Property

Recently updated 

Richard Todd and LWK Group are delighted to present no 2 The grove to the Rush Co Dublin Property market..

No. 2 The Grove is a recently updated three-bedroom semi-detached end of terrace family home, ideally positioned on a quiet road in St Catherine’s, Rush, Co. Dublin. Occupying a desirable corner position, the property benefits from a front garden, driveway parking and a private rear garden with side access. On arrival, you are presented with a welcoming front garden and driveway leading to the property. Entering the house, you are welcomed into a bright and airy porch with tiled flooring. To the left is the front living room, which features a charming fireplace and a large window overlooking the front garden, allowing an abundance of natural light to fill the room and creating a bright and comfortable living space.

Moving through the hallway, you enter the modern open-plan kitchen and dining area, which forms the heart of this family home. The kitchen has been recently renovated and provides an abundance of base and eye-level storage, offering both practicality and style. The dining area is bright and spacious, with double doors leading directly out to the private rear garden, which also benefits from side access, making it ideal for family living, outdoor dining and entertaining.

Upstairs, there are three well-appointed bedrooms comprising two double bedrooms and one single bedroom, together with a family bathroom fitted with quality sanitary ware. The property has been lovingly maintained and upgraded over the years and is presented to the market in excellent condition, offering a comfortable home with further potential for the new owners to make it their own.

The location is particularly appealing, with Rush offering a wonderful combination of coastal living, local amenities and excellent commuter connections. Rush is a popular seaside town in North County Dublin and is located approximately 5km from Skerries and close to Lusk and Balbriggan. The town is well known for its beautiful coastline and sandy beaches, with Rush North Beach and Rush South Beach providing excellent opportunities for seaside walks, recreation and enjoying the outdoors.

The nearby town of Skerries is also within easy reach and offers a wide selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, pubs and leisure facilities, together with its attractive harbour and beaches. Rush itself provides a good range of everyday amenities, including local shops, cafés, restaurants, sporting clubs and community facilities, while the surrounding towns provide further shopping and services.

For families, the area is well served by local schools, with primary and secondary school options available in Rush and the surrounding area. Transport links are also convenient, with Rush & Lusk railway station providing commuter services towards Dublin and Drogheda/Dundalk, while local bus services provide connections to Rush, Skerries and surrounding areas. The M1 is readily accessible, providing convenient access towards Dublin Airport, Dublin City Centre and the wider Dublin road network.

With its quiet location, corner position, driveway parking, private rear garden, recently renovated kitchen and well-proportioned three-bedroom accommodation, No. 2 The Grove is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers. The property represents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, families and investors alike to acquire a well-maintained and upgraded home in a popular coastal location.
